messages:
support-bot: Ticket #58213 from acct-team: multiple 502s and TLS handshake failures reported after scheduled cert rotation last night. Customer says only their VPC is impacted; public tests look OK. Attached: customer tcpdump + nginx 502 logs.

alex: pinging in. can we get an openssl s_client from inside customer's vpc (or from their client) to see chain?

maria: customer pasted their s_client output: 
```
CONNECTED(00000003)
---
Certificate chain
 0 s:/CN=api.acct.internal
   i:/CN=Intermediate CA
---
Server certificate
subject=/CN=api.acct.internal
issuer=/CN=Intermediate CA
---
No client certificate CA names sent
---
SSL handshake has read 2012 bytes and written 456 bytes
---
verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
```

maria: they only see the leaf served, not the intermediate.

samir: hmm. rotator logs show bundle upload succeeded and included intermediate: `rotator:bundle_id=cb-7f8 include_chain=true` and S3 object `cert-bundle-cb-7f8.pem` has 3 certs.

alex: so server bundle on edge is missing the intermediate, but rotator stored it. could be nginx/haproxy parsing dropped it on config reload, or customer reverse-proxy reloading trimmed the chain. any nginx/haproxy reload logs?

maria: customer sent haproxy config snippet and `cat /etc/haproxy/certs/api.pem` shows only the leaf. they admitted they have a config step that concatenates uploaded bundle into a single file but a cleanup script runs during reload that strips everything after the first cert (it was for an old tool).

jen: that explains why public tests (where we terminate) were fine. But why did they start seeing failures only after rotation? were earlier bundles including intermediate on that host?

maria: previous bundle had the intermediate copied to the host manually. rotator replaced it with new bundle and the customer's reload script removed extras. so now chain incomplete.

alex: ok, fix path: 1) temp workaround = re-add intermediate to the host's pem and reload. 2) longer-term = update their reload script to preserve chain or make rotator upload a combined bundle that matches their tooling (or change their loader). 3) recommend they allow AIA/OCSP egress to CA if clients fetch missing intermediates.

ops-oncall: one more wrinkle — customer also has a strict egress allowlist that blocks `ca.example.net` where the intermediate AIA URL points. so even if clients tried AIA fetch, the firewall would block it. thats probably why only their VPC hit the issue.

samir: can we reproduce the egress block impact? i ran `curl -v` to AIA URL from a sandbox that blocks egress and saw `curl: (7) Failed to connect` and openssl verify against the incomplete chain fails with `unable to get local issuer certificate`.

alex: paste repro commands in thread for docs?

samir: sure.

```
# from a host that mimics their VPC (egress blocked)
openssl s_client -connect api.acct.internal:443 -showcerts 
# output shows only leaf cert, no intermediate
openssl verify -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-bundle.crt leaf.pem
# -> error: unable to get local issuer certificate

# from a host with egress allowed to AIA URL
curl -sSf https://ca.example.net/intermediate.crt -o intermediate.crt
cat leaf.pem intermediate.crt > combined.pem
openssl s_client -connect api.acct.internal:443 -CAfile combined.pem -showcerts
# -> verify OK
```

maria: sent the immediate remediation steps to customer: re-copy full bundle to host and disable the cleanup line in their reload script; allowed them to test staging first.

support-bot: customer confirmed temporary fix applied at 2024-10-02T09:22Z and 502s stopped.

jen: follow-ups: 1) change rotator docs to call out setups that strip extras (common in older deploy scripts) and recommend hosting full `fullchain.pem` separately; 2) add a rotator option to publish a single-file `for-legacy-loaders.pem` that concatenates in a single expected order and filename; 3) add advisory to customers with strict egress allowlists to permit intermediate/AIA and OCSP endpoints (provide domain/IP list).

alex: filing internal ticket to add rotator `bundle-compat` upload (RT#INT-9346). tagging @ops-oncall for any infra changes needed. :eyes:

ops-oncall: noted. i've also put a short KB draft in /docs/support/ about common loader behaviors and firewall gotchas. will ping you for review. :white_check_mark:

samir: closing when KB published and rotator option scoped. customer happy.

maria: thanks all — customer said their monitoring returned to green. closing thread. :tada:
